title: Keto Syrian-Style Kebabs with Peanuts
description: A keto twist on traditional Syrian kebabs, featuring juicy lamb and crunchy peanuts. Serve with your favorite sides for a satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oregano, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While kebabs are cooking, toast peanuts in a dry pan over medium heat.
Once kebabs are done, brush with olive oil and serve with toasted peanuts and kissed (if using).
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
